faq_local_1_q: How do I play chess on SupaChess?
faq_local_1_a: Click on 'ChessNova Teacher' in the hub. Choose your level and start playing against the AI!
faq_local_2_a: SupaEngine is our hybrid chess engine (~3150 ELO) combining Stockfish, neural networks and Q-learning.
faq_local_3_q: How do I analyze my games?
faq_local_3_a: Use the Chess Coach! Import your PGN or Lichess game for a detailed analysis of every move.
faq_local_4_q: How does the level system work?
faq_local_4_a: 6 levels from Beginner to Grandmaster. The AI adapts to your strength with personalized suggestions.
faq_local_5_q: How do I suggest a legendary game?
faq_local_5_a: Click on 'Suggest a Game' in the Legendary section. Provide the PGN and historical context.
